title: Instagram Reels arrive on Apple TV
excerpt: Instagram expands to the big screen with a new Apple TV app designed for watching Reels, live streams, and other video content.
body_html:
Instagram has launched a dedicated app for Apple TV, bringing its video content to living room screens. The platform allows users to view Reels, live streams, and other video content scaled up for television displays.

This release follows earlier testing phases that began in December of the previous year, when the company first explored bringing its video-focused format to larger screens. Additional features were subsequently introduced in June ahead of the official launch.
